title: Custom session token verification fails with 'jwt not active' or 'jwt expired' in an embedded Shopify app
symptoms: InvalidJwtError: Failed to parse session token
Requests fail when a session token is reused after about a minute
cause: Session tokens live for one minute and carry an nbf claim, so a server clock a few seconds behind rejects them and cached tokens expire quickly. The official library allows 10 seconds of clock skew, while hand-rolled jwt.verify calls allow none.
fix: Fetch a fresh token with shopify.idToken() for every request, keep server time synced, and pass a small clock tolerance when verifying yourself.
affected: Embedded Shopify apps using App Bridge session tokens; @shopify/shopify-api tolerates 10 s, custom verifiers often 0
